Container.Name: Amberwave
Container.Overview: Amberwave is a self-hosted music server for people who care about their collection and how it sounds – without subscription and without cloud.[br][br] - Library based on MusicBrainz: multiple artists per album, editions, credits, artist pages[br] - Web app / PWA for phone and desktop, streaming from anywhere via Cloudflare Tunnel (no open ports), live transcoding to Opus/AAC[br] - Remote control between devices[br] - Windows client with bit-perfect output (WASAPI exclusive, ASIO), output routing and VST3 effects[br] - Built-in tube, transformer and tape saturation and room sound[br] - Family accounts; the music folder stays read-only until you allow writing in the app[br][br] All-in-one: MariaDB 11.8 LTS is included, no second container needed. Set your music folder and an admin user name and password below, start, open the WebUI and log in. Public beta.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web app, the Windows client and the phones.

Config.Name: Music
Config.Description: Your music collection. Amberwave only reads it until you allow writing under Settings › Library (for renaming and tagging). Set the access mode to read-only for hard protection.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, covers, artist images and backups. Keep it on the cache SSD.

Config.Name: Admin user name
Config.Description: Only needed for the very first setup: creates the first admin account (3–50 characters: letters, digits, . _ -). Clearing this field afterwards is recommended – the account keeps working. Leave empty to create the account on the setup page in the browser instead.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Only needed for the very first setup (at least 8 characters). Clearing this field after your first login is recommended – the account keeps working. Change the password later in Amberwave under Profile.

Config.Name: Admin e-mail
Config.Description: Optional e-mail address of the admin (password reset, notices).

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Optional: folder with finished music downloads from SABnzbd or Tidarr (e.g. /mnt/user/downloads/complete/music) for automatic import.

Config.Name: HTTPS port (home network)
Config.Description: Direct HTTPS access in your home network with your own certificate (Settings › Access & network). No port forwarding needed.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID Amberwave and its database run as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: Database memory
Config.Description: Memory MariaDB keeps for data and indexes. 1G or more for libraries with 100,000+ tracks.
